description: Source code for managing OpenType CFF font objects within the FreeType project, including size, slot, face, and driver functions, as well as font initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: cff_size_get_globals_funcs
methods.description: Retrieves the global hints functions for a given CFF size object.

methods.name: cff_size_done
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a CFF_Size object.

methods.name: cff_make_private_dict
methods.description: Synthesizes a Type 1 private dictionary from a CFF subfont.

methods.name: cff_size_init
methods.description: Initializes a CFF_Size object, creating internal structures.

methods.name: cff_size_select
methods.description: Selects a specific strike (size) for a CFF font.

methods.name: cff_size_request
methods.description: Requests size metrics for a CFF font, setting scale and other parameters.

methods.name: cff_slot_done
methods.description: Finalizes a glyph slot, clearing hints.

methods.name: cff_slot_init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph slot, setting up hints if available.

methods.name: remove_subset_prefix
methods.description: Removes subset prefix from font name strings.

methods.name: remove_style
methods.description: Removes style suffix from family name strings.

methods.name: cff_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a CFF font face, loading font data and setting properties.

methods.name: cff_face_done
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a CFF font face.

methods.name: cff_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes the CFF driver with default settings.
